blurb: Escape to Spacious Skies Peach Haven, your idyllic South Carolina retreat! Nestled amidst rolling hills near the iconic Gaffney Peachoid, our campground offers everything from full hook-up RV sites and cozy cabins to shaded, pet-friendly spots. Hike serene trails, fish in our ponds, or get active with mini-golf, a seasonal pool, and more.
